summary.text: 么 is the standardized simplified form of 麽, used in simplified Chinese for an interrogative particle. It is also recorded as a variant of 幺, a separate use associated with “small” or “fine.”

formation.text: This character has two documented relationships: an older lexicographic association with 幺 and its standardization as the simplified counterpart of 麽 in 1956. The available evidence does not establish how the 么 and 幺 shapes are graphically related, so no internal component analysis is warranted.

history.text: 么 is recorded as a variant of 幺, but the timing and graphic basis of that relationship are unclear. A modern seal-style redraw of 幺 illustrates the form cited in the traditional analysis of 麽; it is not an early form of 么.
In 1956, the simplification scheme paired 么 with 麽 as standardized counterparts. This is a whole-character relationship, not evidence of a component substitution within 么.

uncertainties.text: The available evidence does not establish the earliest forms or graphic evolution of 么 and 幺, or the precise basis of their recorded variant relationship.

senses.text: A small or fine use is cited for 么, including in 么虫. The evidence does not establish whether this meaning continues a sense associated with 幺 or 麽.

senses.gloss: interrogative or sentence-final particle; postposed element
senses.text: In simplified Chinese, 么 writes interrogative and postposed uses also written 麼 in traditional Chinese. Cited literary examples attest these uses but do not date the earliest surviving spellings.

limitations.text: The evidence does not establish a semantic transition from “small” or “fine” to particle uses. Proposed histories involving 何物, 物, and 無 concern the spoken interrogative word and its spellings; they do not establish how the graph 么 was formed or borrowed.

overview.text: 么 is the standardized simplified form of 麽, used for interrogative and related postposed forms in simplified Chinese. It is also recorded separately as a variant of 幺.

takeaway.text: The separately cited “small” or “fine” use does not show that the particle developed from that meaning.

relationships.text: 么 is recorded as a variant associated with 幺, though the timing and precise graphic basis of the relationship are unclear.
The 1956 simplification scheme pairs 么 with 麽 as standardized simplified counterparts.
